title: REQ · Admin execution endpoints incl. retry and approve are registered from the table and reject missing and wrong tokens
summary: The three admin execution routes join the route table, and each returns 401 for missing or wrong tokens.
description: Context: execution routes (list, retry, approve) are registered inline in server.go L103-L105 and have no server-level auth test. Desired behavior: they are entries in the same table. Expected result: 401 for missing and wrong tokens, not 401 for the correct token.
acceptance_criteria: Given the route table, when built, then it also lists GET /executions, POST /executions/{id}/retry, POST /executions/{id}/approve.
Given a server with token 'tok', when an execution route is called with no token or 'Bearer wrong', then the response is 401.
Given the same server, when retry and approve are called with 'Bearer tok', then the response is not 401.

in_scope: Execution entries in the route table

definition_of_done: Execution routes registered from the table
